versions.subject: feat: new rules related to `dotnet-dump`
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\dotnet-dump.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'dotnet-dump.dll'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains: 'collect'
condition: all of selection_*
